name: Remote MCP Server (Authless)
description: A template for deploying authentication-free MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers. Provides a starting point for building remote MCP servers with custom tools that can be accessed from Claude Desktop or the Cloudflare AI Playground via Server-Sent Events.
